business_scope.primary_industry_name: Corporate Scope 1-3 Carbon Footprint Auditing and Offset Brokerage

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English common law, French civil law and customary law, with separate statute-based international company law

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222], ss 11-12 (name clearance) and ss 127-133 (registered office and registered agent); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 (customer due diligence, PEPs and UBO identification); Company and Trust Services Providers Act 2021 (licensed registered agent obligations and beneficial ownership register); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 300], ss 3-7 (regulatory powers); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2018 (reporting and suspicious transaction purposes).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary public, public notary office or state immigration authority issuing the identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the originating jurisdiction is a 1961 Hague Convention member) or Consular Legalization at a Vanuatu embassy/accredited consulate for non-Hague countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating regulated bank, signed by the branch manager or authorised officer with bank stamp
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization where a corporate shareholder is involved; otherwise accepted as direct correspondence from a FATF-compliant jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional legal or accounting reference, including sworn source of wealth and source of funds declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing lawyer, notary, certified public accountant or regulated financial adviser in the applicant's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization, as required under Vanuatu AML/CFT supervisory guidance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or certified company extract of each corporate shareholder / parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-state companies registry or official corporate registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; certified English translation must accompany non-English-language documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN), UK HMT Financial Sanctions, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List and Vanuatu's domestic terrorist financing schedules. All proposed directors, shareholders, registered agents and UBOs are subject to PEP identification, including family members and close associates. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) applies to PEPs with verification of source of wealth and source of funds. Continuous transaction monitoring and re-screening at least every 90 days and upon any material trigger event. Negative news and adverse-media checks must be performed using reputable commercial compliance databases such as World-Check or equivalent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies Registry (VFSC Online Services portal at vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be rendered in Latin script (A-Z, 0-9). English and French names are accepted; Bislama names are accepted only if transliterated into Latin alphabet. Names are subject to Registry supervisory discretion for readability and order. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Société Anonyme', 'SA' or another suffix permitted by the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. Non-Latin-script names must be anglicised transliterations and may be rejected if not clearly distinguishable or if phonetically confused with an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed registered agent files with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) a written appeal for reconsideration within 14 days from the date of the notice. The appeal must cite the proposed name, the ground of rejection, and any available consent from the relevant Minister or competent authority for sensitive tokens. Where the name is rejected due to resemblance to an existing name, a substituted name marker may be proposed. If the VFSC maintains the refusal, the applicant may seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under ordinary civil procedure. Name reservation may be renewed by re-submission and payment of a fresh application fee; there is no statutory right to extension beyond the initial 30-day reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are permissible for this industry. The licensed registered agent must maintain the sole statutory registered office at a physical address in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and all statutory mail, notices and service of process are received there. The international company may operate entirely from offshore without physical premises in Vanuatu. However, the registered agent cannot delegate the registered office; the IC must keep its registered agent advised of current directors, shareholders and UBOs, and board resolutions, minutes, registers and accounting records must be accessible at or through the registered agent's office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 10–15% estimated likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection by VFSC or the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit within the first operating year for this standard-risk, non-licensed ESG/carbon advisory IC. The likelihood rises above 15% if the selected registered agent is under heightened AML/CFT supervisory attention or if the IC's transaction profile becomes inconsistent with its declared business purpose.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), sections 2, 6-8, 12-15, 26-32 and 37-41; Companies Act [Cap 191] (residual application); Business Licence Act [Cap 244]; Value Added Tax Act No. 13 of 2013 (registration threshold only)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division and Companies Registry, Rue Pasteur, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (International Company) plus Notice of Registered Office and Notice of Directors and Officers filed with the Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up or issued share capital is imposed by the International Companies Act; the Memorandum of Association commonly declares authorized capital of USD 50,000 or less to remain within the standard VFSC fee band. No escrow account or capital deposit is required; shares may be issued at par on subscriber declaration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION NO. 1 - FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS

RESOLVED that the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission are adopted and ratified.

RESOLVED that the allotment of ordinary shares to each subscriber at par value, as recorded in the share register, is approved.

RESOLVED that the registered office at the office of the Licensed Agent, Port Vila, is confirmed and the agent is authorized to act for the Company.

RESOLVED that [Name] is appointed Director, [Name] is appointed Secretary, and [Name] is appointed Compliance Officer, with authority to execute agreements, open bank accounts, and appoint SWIFT wire signatories.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry, Port Vila (via licensed registered agent or VFSC e-portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed Latin-character company name (ending 'Limited') together with a one-line business purpose to the VFSC for desirability screening under section 12 of the International Companies Act; verify that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to a registered local or international company; upon approval, reserve the name for a 20-working-day retention period pending filing.
required_dossiers: Statement of principal activity (ESG carbon footprint auditing and offset brokerage)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as undesirable or conflicting, file an alternative name through the agent; an appeal against refusal may be addressed to the Registrar of International Companies under section 12(4), with a decision normally rendered within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of Constitution Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (VFSC licensee) with oath administered before a Notary Public or Commissioner for Oaths, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association adopting the standard IC provisions (share class, director powers, indemnity); execute the memorandum by each subscriber in the presence of the notary; affix notarial certificate to all signature pages; prepare the statutory Forms for registered office and directors for simultaneous filing.
required_dossiers: Notice of Directors and Officers (Form IC-5)
Certified passport copies and proof of residence for directors and shareholders
Beneficial ownership declaration under VFSC AML/CFT Rule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or agent identifies execution defects, replace affected signature pages and re-execute before the notary; where the VFSC queries the forms, the agent files corrective Form IC-5 within 14 days without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Port Vila (paper or agent e-submission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Memorandum and Articles together with the statutory notices and agent consent at the VFSC Registry; pay the USD 250 government registration fee (plus prescribed stamp duties if any) by wire or bank draft; obtain the VFSC stamped acknowledgment and provisional file number.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Resident agent undertaking for custody of company records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for missing attachments, the registered agent remedies the deficiency in a single re-filing cycle; VFSC practice allows an interim certificate where only formal amendments remain.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Legal Commencement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number and date; the company's separate legal personality commences on that date under section 8 of the International Companies Act; verify the certificate details against the filed application before distribution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Typographical errors in the certificate are corrected on written request of the agent with a replacement certificate issued within 2 working days; substantive corrections require a rectification filing under VFSC form practice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance: Statutory Registers, Officers' Consents and First Board Recognition
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and the licensed Registered Agent (custodian of statutory books)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 21 days of incorporation, file directors' and secretary's consents to act; open the statutory registers (members, directors, secretary, charges) at the registered office; minute the first board resolution; issue share certificates to the subscribers; designate bank account signatories and SWIFT wire approvers.
required_dossiers: Form IC-6 consent to act (directors and secretary)
Share register and register of directors
Certified signatory list for bank mandates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing of consents attracts a nominal late fee which may be waived on good-cause affidavit; defective share registers are rectified by the agent under a director's resolution and resubmitted to the VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence and VAT Registration (Local Nexus Assessment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licence Unit, Department of Finance and Treasury, Port Vila; Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VAT) if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Assess whether the company has local business nexus; where the IC only carries on offshore advisory and brokerage activities, submit a written exemption request under the Business Licence Act with a copy of the Certificate of Incorporation; if a Port Vila office is occupied, pay the annual business licence fee based on declared turnover; register for VAT only if taxable supplies exceed the statutory threshold.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A refused or contested licence may be appealed to the Minister of Finance within 21 days; where local nexus is inadvertent, restructure by moving all management activity to the registered agent's office and re-apply for exemption.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licence Unit, Department of Finance and Treasury, Port Vila; Port Vila Municipal Council for premises certification; VFSC as sector supervisor
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business Licence (Category: Management Consultancy and Accounting Advisory - ESG Carbon Auditing) issued under the Business Licence Act [Cap 244]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Port Vila
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Tier C - Registration/Exempt: office-based professional services generate no prescribed activity listed in the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap 283]; an optional Environmental Compliance Registration notice is lodged for carbon offset brokerage records
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC sources; domestic sanitary wastewater discharged to Port Vila municipal sewerage per Water and Sanitation Standards; zero on-site combustion emissions; office e-waste, batteries and toner cartridges must be surrendered to DEPC-approved recyclers under the Waste Management Act; carbon verification workpapers retained 7 years for client audit continuity

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Rescue Section covering extinguishers, egress routes and quarterly evacuation drill; structural occupancy clearance for the office floor from the Port Vila Municipal Building Authority against seismic and cyclone load requirements; workplace health and safety clearance under the Employment Act [Cap 160] including first-aid provisioning and staff safety induction; business continuity plan addressing tropical cyclone risk for client data archives

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; operational portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, so an International Company (IC) does not obtain an income-tax TIN. A foreign-owned entity registers with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and receives an IC registration number. If the entity enters the indirect-tax net by making taxable supplies in or into Vanuatu, it must apply to VRC for a VAT identification number (VATIN) using the VRC VAT registration form, with the VFSC certificate, articles/incorporation certificate, registered office address, expected 12-month taxable turnover, principal place of business and bank details, and a written local fiscal representative appointment where there is no Vanuatu fixed establishment. Exporting physical goods additionally requires an ASYCUDA World Customs exporter code; a pure offshore service IC that conducts no Vanuatu domestic taxable activity remains outside the VAT register and may simply rely on its IC exemption certificate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box entity classification election and no hybrid mismatch or treaty election exist under Vanuatu law. An IC's tax-exempt classification is automatic upon VFSC incorporation and cannot be altered. A business below the VAT threshold may elect voluntary VAT registration, and an exporter may apply for a ruling confirming zero-rating; neither election changes the IC's income-tax exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Vanuatu Value Added Tax Act, administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 (four million vatu) of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; voluntary registration is available for smaller turnover
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, API e-invoicing, or digital stamping. VAT-registered suppliers must issue prescribed tax invoices and retain supporting documents. Export control is managed electronically through the ASYCUDA World customs declaration and clearance system, which functions as the fiscal clearance event for exported goods; no separate API invoicing clearance is imposed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAT-registered supplier may zero-rate the export of goods physically removed from Vanuatu and specified offshore services supplied to a non-resident recipient for use or enjoyment outside Vanuatu. For corporate ESG/carbon footprint auditing and offset brokerage, zero-rating is claimable where the client is a non-resident, the service is not performed on land or property located in Vanuatu, no local consumption occurs, and the contract/invoice states the offshore destination. If the carbon offset brokerage is characterized as arranging financial products, it may fall within an exempt financial-services category rather than zero-rated supply, so a binding VRC interpretation should be obtained where this is material.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed electronically in ASYCUDA World
Commercial invoice and signed export/offshore service contract
Bill of Lading, air waybill, or other transport document proving physical export
Packing list and Certificate of Origin where a preferential origin claim is made
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank SWIFT/MT103 / foreign exchange confirmation evidencing receipt of offshore funds
VRC VAT export schedule / zero-rated supplies schedule, if requested on audit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC auditors may compare export declarations, transport documents, bank remittance evidence, and service contracts before refunding or recognizing input credits. Any unsupported zero-rating is retrospectively clawed back: the supply is reassessed at 12.5% VAT, input credits are disallowed, and late-payment interest and penalties accrue from the original due date. Knowingly false or fraudulent zero-rating claims and customs misdeclarations expose the entity and responsible officers to civil penalties, imprisonment under the VAT/Customs Acts, loss of IC tax-exempt status, and VFSC enforcement action.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) acts as the parallel licensing and AML/CFT supervisor for non-bank financial services and International Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible in both current and capital accounts. The Exchange Control Act [Cap 91] remains on the statute book, but section 126 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] expressly exempts all International Companies from exchange-control regulations. No RBV approval, licence, or reporting is required for capital injections, profit repatriation, dividend payments, directors' fees, or cross-border service fees in any currency. The VU_IC, as a tax-exempt International Company engaged in Scope 1-3 carbon auditing and offset brokerage, derives service income in USD/EUR/AUD and faces no remittance hurdles, no withholding taxes, and no restrictions on holding foreign-currency bank accounts onshore or offshore.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Vanuatu imposes no statutory deadline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds or cross-border service receipts. The residual surrender provisions of the Exchange Control Act [Cap 91] apply only to non-IC resident entities and are not enforced by RBV in current practice. The VU_IC may retain 100% of its export-service and brokerage receipts in the original invoice currency, hold them in USD/EUR/AUD accounts, and deploy them without conversion to VUV.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multi-Currency Account / USD Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account in USD/EUR/VUV / Brokerage Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury rail. Vanuatu has no domestic e-money institution (EMI) or payment-institution licensing category, and VFSC financial-dealer licences do not authorise digital wallet issuance. The VU_IC may lawfully hold balances with reputable offshore EMIs, but such accounts are outside RBV/VFSC regulatory perimeter and are treated as heightened-risk by correspondent banks in Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and Hong Kong. Feasibility: supplementary receivable-collection channel only, with full beneficial-owner disclosure, exact invoice matching, and monthly sweep to the primary ANZ/BRED Vanuatu account; not suitable for capital escrow or settlement of offset purchases.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical branch attendance is not statutorily mandated under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act 2019 or VFSC AML/CFT Rules. ANZ Vanuatu and BRED Vanuatu permit remote onboarding for low-risk International Companies through secure video interview, digitally notarised board resolutions, apostilled certificates of incumbency, and a banker's reference from the owning institution. However, the prescribed AML risk-committee practice requires at least one natural-person director to complete a live video KYC interview, and for the first account, a notarised or apostilled passport verification conducted in person before a recognised notary is strongly advised. NBV generally insists on a face-to-face branch visit for non-resident entities, reducing its practical utility for an offshore IC structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner domiciled in a FATF-monitored or high-risk jurisdiction, or lacking an economic nexus to Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid passport and proof of address dated within 6 months; tax-residency certificate issued by the owner's home tax authority; source-of-wealth statement supported by asset-sale deeds, dividend vouchers, payroll records, or brokerage statements; professional CV establishing the ESG advisory nexus; and a reference letter from a premier OECD-regulated bank evidencing a minimum 3-year relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company structure utilising nominee directors, custodial shareholders, or discretionary trusts that obscure the ultimate beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete register of directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners (individuals holding 10% or more); nominee declaration executed by the VFSC-licensed custodian of records; trust deed or purpose-trust declaration where applicable; and a written legal opinion from a Vanuatu-licensed agent confirming compliance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222], including the section 126 exchange-control exemption and accuracy of the beneficial-ownership register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Carbon-credit trading or offset-brokerage counterparties located in higher-risk jurisdictions without a documented audit trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed commercial contracts and purchase orders for each offset purchase; certified carbon-registry serial numbers and retirement records from Verra, Gold Standard, or ACR; a counterparty AML/KYC due-diligence pack including licence evidence; and a flow-of-funds narrative that maps each invoice to the corresponding registry credit serial and settlement entry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected transaction velocity or cumulative turnover disproportionate to the entity's age, paid-up capital, and stated business model
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or accountant-reviewed 2-year pro-forma financial statements; signed ESG advisory engagement letters and Scope 1-3 carbon-audit master service agreements; a 12-month cash-flow forecast detailing projected offset volumes, fee milestones, and correspondent-bank routing; and a board resolution authorising the treasury structure and referencing the tax-exempt International Company status.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions and subscription proceeds are remitted via SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's bank to the VU_IC account at ANZ Vanuatu or BRED Vanuatu. The beneficiary reference must read 'Capital Contribution to Vanuatu International Company [legal name]' and the remittance narrative in field 70 must cite the International Companies Act [Cap 222], section 126 exchange-control exemption. No RBV filing, import certificate, or prior approval is necessary. The receiving bank will verify current registration and good standing with VFSC, confirm the remitter appears on the beneficial-ownership register, and reconcile the amount against the filed registered capital (no minimum capital applies). For carbon-audit fee income, each inbound credit must reference a defined ESG deliverable — Scope 1-3 carbon inventory, carbon-footprint verification, or offset-brokerage commission — so the MT103 narration matches the underlying commercial contract. Settlement verification comprises SWIFT GPI tracking alerts, same-day bank credit confirmation, and monthly reconciliation against the custom treasury ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary outbound clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for direct advisory-fee disbursements to overseas consultants, verification bodies, and audit partners, and for carbon-credit purchase settlements with registry counterparties in USD, EUR, or AUD. Where the IC acts as principal in a bundled offsets transaction and funds a third-party registry or trustee account, SWIFT MT202 COVER is used to settle correspondent obligations in conjunction with the beneficiary's MT103. Commercial letters of credit are not market standard for ESG advisory services but may be requested for large offset-purchase programmes exceeding USD 2,000,000; in such cases a sight LC confirmed by a Schedule-1 OECD bank is executed through ANZ Vanuatu's trade-finance desk. Domestic VUV clearing is available only for incidental local expenses and is settled through the RBV real-time gross settlement system via NBV; all material cross-border flows bypass the domestic system entirely and clear through ANZ's Australian correspondent network and BRED's Paris/Hong Kong network.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable forwards in USD/EUR/AUD against VUV executed at the ANZ Vanuatu or BRED Vanuatu corporate FX desk for receivables denominated in VUV from domestic counterparties.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (USD/VUV and AUD/VUV) arranged via Singapore or Hong Kong prime brokers; permitted without RBV approval because the IC is exempt under section 126 of the International Companies Act and NDF settlement occurs in USD.
Cross-currency swaps (USD-AUD and EUR-USD) for balance-sheet hedging of multi-currency fee receipts and committed offset-purchase liabilities, subject to an approved board treasury policy.
Option collars and vanilla EUR/USD and AUD/USD purchased options on a covered basis for committed offset-purchase campaigns exceeding USD 500,000.
Roll-forward purchase contracts for future carbon-credit inventory denominated in AUD, aligned with Australian carbon credit unit (ACCU) settlement cycles and executed through ANZ Markets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after each anniversary of incorporation; no extension regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of VT 5,000 per month or part-month; continued default triggers a VFSC 30-day strike-off notice followed by administrative dissolution and vesting of company assets in the Government.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Annual Re-appointment Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent (filed with VFSC by the agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failing to maintain a licensed registered agent and Vanuatu registered office is a continuing offence under section 16; VFSC may strike off the company for non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Confirmation (attached to the Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via the registered agent; register maintained at the Vanuatu registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the Annual Return; event-based updates for any shareholding transfer must be filed within 14 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Deficient beneficial ownership records constitute an offence under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act with fines up to VT 1,000,000 plus daily continuing fines; persistent breach supports administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard tax-exempt International Company; an independent statutory audit is compulsory only if the company holds a regulated financial or insurance licence under the VFSC Act. This IC is audit-exempt in the absence of such licensing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; Vanuatu has no separate domestic GAAP. Accounting records must sufficiently show and explain all transactions and present a fair view of the company's financial position.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Directors must identify all registrable beneficial owners, record any share transfer or ownership change within 14 days, and attest to the completeness and accuracy of the beneficial ownership register when the Annual Return is filed with the VFSC. No separate UBO filing fee is prescribed.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$400-US$900 per annum depending on service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable for audit-exempt IC; voluntary audit US$3,000-US$7,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu abolished corporate income tax under the Income Tax (Abolition) Act No. 34 of 2005; an International Company (IC) holding a valid VFSC Certificate of Incorporation is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu income taxation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective corporate tax; perpetual tax-exempt status of the IC under Section 111 of the International Companies Act Cap 222; no capital gains tax, no withholding tax on dividends, no payroll tax for non-resident employees, no wealth or inheritance tax for non-residents; VAT (12.5%) applies only to prescribed supplies made within Vanuatu and generally does not attach to offshore carbon advisory or brokerage services rendered to non-residents.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return is assessable. The mandatory compliance filing is the Annual Return of an International Company (International Companies Act Cap 222, Section 174), submitted through the VFSC-licensed Registered Agent via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) electronic registry and Companies Office portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return and annual government maintenance fee are due within 6 months of each anniversary of incorporation. The initial Annual Return must be filed within 6 months of incorporation; a nil-activity declaration is permissible only where no transaction has been undertaken.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the International Company exactly as registered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact English name; no translation or suffix variation (e.g., Ltd, Corp) is permitted without prior VFSC approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC registration number and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Copy from the Certificate of Incorporation; cross-check with the Registered Agent to prevent mismatch that triggers rejection.
Must be a physical address in Port Vila or Luganville maintained by the Registered Agent; a P.O. Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered Agent name, licensed registration number, and street address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent may complete this box; the non-resident owner cannot self-certify.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors: full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and dates of appointment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide a certified copy of the director's passport; nominee directors require a signed declaration of their nominee status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders and beneficial owners: name, nationality, address, and shareholding percentage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ultimate beneficial ownership must be disclosed to the Registered Agent for AML record-keeping; bearer shares are prohibited for new ICs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital, classes of shares, and consideration received.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State capital in Vatu or foreign currency; non-resident owners may hold 100% without exchange control consent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of business activity and non-transaction with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Certify that carbon accounting, ESG audit, and offset brokerage services are performed exclusively outside Vanuatu and that no domestic supply to Vanuatu-resident persons has occurred.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act and AML/CFT obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signed by a director or the Registered Agent; false declarations attract criminal liability under Section 230 of the Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of VT 25,000 per month or part-month of default, plus reinstatement fees if struck off. Persistent non-filing triggers a Registrar's strike-off notice under Section 263, dissolution of the IC, forfeiture of assets to the State after 7 years, and a 5-year ban on the directors engaging any VFSC-regulated entity.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no domestic dividend withholding tax; an IC may distribute all profits to non-resident shareholders free of Vanuatu tax, and no stamp duty applies to dividend resolutions or transfer of dividend proceeds.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive Double Tax Agreement (DTA) network and only participates in limited Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs). To substantiate non-residency for source-country treaty credit or relief in the shareholder's home state, the following protocol applies: (1) submit a written request with supporting board resolution to the IC's Registered Agent; (2) the Registered Agent files Form T-1 (Certificate of Tax Status) with the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury (Tax Division); (3) the Tax Division verifies the IC's exemption status and non-resident shareholding and issues a Certificate of Tax Status / Residence Confirmation within 5-10 business days; (4) the certificate, accompanied by the IC's Certificate of Incorporation and Annual Return receipt, is presented to the foreign paying agent or tax authority. No double-tax relief is available from Vanuatu itself as there is no domestic income tax to offset.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory WHT rate: 0% on interest and royalties paid by an IC to non-residents. Treaty effect: no Vanuatu DTA reduces further; the practical risk is the foreign counterparty's source-state WHT (commonly 10-30% on outbound royalties) unless the IC proves its Vanuatu non-residence or structures the flow through a jurisdiction with a favorable network (e.g., Singapore, Hong Kong). Interest on shareholder loans is also exempt from Vanuatu tax but must be documented at arm's length to avoid recharacterization in the lender's home state.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold in Vatu because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax and has no domestic TP law. Foreign threshold triggers apply only where a foreign tax authority recharacterizes the IC as a tax resident or permanent establishment of a related enterprise; in such cases the OECD-recommended thresholds govern (e.g., Local File above EUR 1,000,000 or Master File above EUR 50,000,000 of related-party turnover). For carbon offset brokerage commissions of USD 500,000 or more annually, prudent compliance requires preparing a contemporaneous transfer pricing memorandum in the buyer's jurisdiction.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP — Comparable Uncontrolled Price (preferred for openly traded carbon credits and audit fees)
Resale Price Method (applicable to carbon credit brokerage and distribution margins)
Cost Plus Method (applicable to ESG advisory and data compilation services)
TNMM — Transactional Net Margin Method (default for routine audit-support activities)
Profit Split Method (appropriate for integrated carbon offset origination and joint ventures)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has no UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations; however, Section 111 and Section 174 of the International Companies Act Cap 222 impose equivalent substance conditions on ICs: (a) maintain a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; (b) maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu; (c) keep accounting records at the registered office that reflect the company's financial position with reasonable accuracy; (d) refrain from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents or holding real property in Vanuatu. The annual return includes an Economic Substance Declaration confirming the company's activities do not create a local economic presence. Failure to satisfy these conditions enables the Registrar to strike off the company and exposes the IC to characterization as a shell entity by foreign courts, particularly in U.S. and EU anti-abuse rules (CFC, GAAR, and DAC6).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exercising central management and control from a high-tax onshore state (e.g., holding board meetings, executing sales contracts, and managing bank signatories in the U.S., E.U., or Australia) while declaring pure Vanuatu non-residence to avoid corporate income tax on carbon audit fees and offset brokerage margins.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign court recharacterization of the IC as a tax resident; reattribution of 100% of profit with interest; penalties of 100-200% of the tax understated; publication on the foreign tax authority's non-cooperative entity list; VFSC cross-sanction for false declaration under Section 230 of the International Companies Act, including revocation of the IC's exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors jointly and severally liable for the foreign unpaid tax and penalties; civil restitution orders equal to the full tax deficiency; 5-10 year travel bans; extradition risk; imprisonment of up to 14 years under the foreign state's criminal tax code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining zero physical substance: no office, no locally stored accounting records, nominee directors with no information, and no records of decisions despite claiming an active ESG carbon accounting and audit business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC strike-off and dissolution under Section 263 of the International Companies Act; liquidation of bank accounts through court order; forfeiture of the company's assets to the Vanuatu State after 7 years; inclusion on the Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information adverse review report, causing loss of correspondent banking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for up to VT 25,000,000 of the IC's outstanding debts if the company continued trading after the strike-off notice; 5-year disqualification from acting as a director of any VFSC-licensed entity; prohibition from reincorporating an IC in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC's Swift/Wire bank account to layer proceeds from fraudulent carbon credit sales, transacting with OFAC, UN, or FATF-sanctioned counterparties, or accepting client funds without the Registered Agent's AML/KYC clearance, despite the IC's Low_Risk_Standard commercial tier.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine of up to VT 25,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 10 years under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act; freezing and confiscation orders over the IC's entire asset base; revocation of the Registered Agent's license and immediate deregistration of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors individually prosecuted where knowledge of the illicit source of funds is proven; personal fines of up to VT 10,000,000; seizure of personal bank accounts; travel restriction orders of up to 3 years; personal restraint orders under the Vanuatu Proceeds of Crime Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unauthorized Domestic Trading / Business License Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Providing carbon footprint auditing, ESG advisory, or carbon credit brokerage services to Vanuatu government bodies, Vanuatu-resident companies, or local charitable organizations without converting the IC to a domestic company and obtaining a business license under the Business Licences Act Cap 242.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of up to VT 1,000,000 plus VT 10,000 per day of continuing default; immediate suspension of the IC's tax-exempt status; criminal prosecution under the International Companies Act; unlawful contracts rendered unenforceable before Vanuatu courts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for unpaid license fees, court costs, and daily fines; civil orders to disgorge all profits derived from the Vanuatu-sourced business; imprisonment of up to 2 years for continuing to trade after a suspension order.
